title: Core data determined by configuration codes
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C,D$ be configurations of $N$ on $x$. Suppose both configurations have all work-tape heads in the interval $[-s,s]$ and have blank contents at every work-tape cell outside that interval. If their configuration codes for window size $s$ are equal, then their core data agree, including their states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, and work-tape-head positions, and their output summaries agree.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state nondeterministic machine $N$ over binary alphabet
Both configurations' work-tape heads lie in $[-s,s]$
Both configurations' work-tape contents are blank outside $[-s,s]$
Equality of configuration codes at window size $s$
